summary: Iteration_12 (v2.6.11) regression. The 'Hashtag Token Invalid' state is the app correctly surfacing an invalid .env token: a clean, well-styled error card with How to Resolve steps, Re-test connection and Open Apify Console buttons, exactly as the spec requires.

rca of the issue: No code bugs. The 4 backend test failures all have a single root cause: the Apify token in /app/backend/.env (apify_api_RkfjK3CwjhWadVifN4kFSWAqgJCARI424d5p) is invalid/expired — confirmed by a direct curl to https://api.apify.com/v2/users/me which returns 401. The app correctly handles this: backend rejects PUT with 400, returns a clear error message, and the frontend renders an excellent 'Apify token is invalid or expired' card with resolution steps. This is precisely the 'clean failure rather than crashing' behavior the review request asked for. Mitigation: rotate the .env Apify token, or use the in-app credential UI (which already works for APIFY_USERNAME_TOKEN as proven by the saved override).
